notes:
{淘汰|とうた} describes the process of elimination through competition or natural processes.

WORD TYPE:
- Noun
- Also used as passive: {淘汰|とうた}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be eliminated/weeded out)

WRITING:
- {淘|とう} (washing, selecting)
- {汰|た} (luxury, washing)
- Original meaning: washing/sifting to separate grain

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}{淘汰|とうた} (natural selection - Darwin's theory)
- {淘汰|とうた}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be eliminated)
- {淘汰|とうた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}き{残|のこ}る→生き残る：13521_ikinokoru⟧ (to survive the selection process)

USAGE:
- Biology (natural selection)
- Business (market competition)
- Society (social Darwinism, controversial)
- Technology (old tech being replaced)
- Can be neutral (scientific) or negative (harsh)
- Implies the weak/unfit are removed
- Often used in business journalism

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}{淘汰|とうた} (natural selection)
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{淘汰|とうた} (market shakeout)
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{淘汰|とうた} (elimination through competition)
- {淘汰|とうた}⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧ (selection pressure)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{選別|せんべつ}→選別：09616_senbetsu⟧ (sorting, selection)
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ (choice, selection)
- ⟦{駆逐|くちく}→駆逐：07979_kuchiku⟧ (expulsion, eradication)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in academic, business, and news contexts.
